paper_statement_and_problem: Successive EfficientNet and ResNet blocks enter MFF → tap indices unspecified
chosen_interpretation: EfficientNet features 2/3/5/7 paired with ResNet layers 1/2/3/4
expected_experimental_consequence: Changes receptive fields, MFF size and parameter count

paper_statement_and_problem: SCGA in first two ResNet blocks, NLB in later blocks → “block” level ambiguous
chosen_interpretation: SCGA after layer1/layer2; NLB after layer3/layer4
justification: Literal four-stage interpretation of Figure 6 text
possible_alternative: Insert inside individual bottlenecks or after different stages

paper_statement_and_problem: SCGA GMA equal groups → group count absent
justification: Divides all chosen ResNet and fusion widths
expected_experimental_consequence: Changes pooling granularity and parameter count

paper_statement_and_problem: Equations 17–22 describe directional statistics but convolution detail is incomplete
chosen_interpretation: Width mean/max produce horizontal H×1 maps; height mean/max produce vertical 1×W maps; each group uses shared per-group 1×1 projections
justification: Preserves axes, group dimensions and stated operation order
possible_alternative: Per-group unshared projections; different axis names

paper_statement_and_problem: SCGA spatial path lists 1×1 layers 64→16(dilation 2)→8→sigmoid mask
possible_alternative: Interpret dilation as implying larger kernel
expected_experimental_consequence: Literal 1×1 dilation has no receptive-field effect

paper_statement_and_problem: Final spatial mask expanded by fixed all-ones convolution → initialization/freeze unclear
chosen_interpretation: Fixed non-trainable 1×1 projection of one mask channel to C channels
expected_experimental_consequence: Fixed version adds no trainable parameters

paper_statement_and_problem: NLB key/value subsampling allowed, factor absent
chosen_interpretation: Average-pool keys/values by two when possible

paper_statement_and_problem: NLB embedding width and output initialization absent
chosen_interpretation: C/2 projection, learned residual output projection
expected_experimental_consequence: Changes parameter count and first-step behavior

paper_statement_and_problem: MFF separable convolution stride 2 stated, kernel/width absent
chosen_interpretation: Depthwise 3×3 stride 2 plus pointwise 1×1 to 128 channels
justification: Standard separable convolution with stated downsampling
expected_experimental_consequence: Changes output detail, compute and parameters

paper_statement_and_problem: Paired feature maps may differ in height/width → alignment absent
chosen_interpretation: Resize both to the lower common spatial dimensions using bilinear interpolation only when needed
justification: Makes mismatch explicit; actual chosen taps already match

paper_statement_and_problem: Concatenate outputs from all MFFs before GAP → different spatial sizes
chosen_interpretation: Resize four MFF outputs to smallest fused map, concatenate, 1×1 reduce, GAP
justification: Implements stated concatenation and GAP with defined tensor operations
expected_experimental_consequence: Changes information retained from fine scales

paper_statement_and_problem: Paper ends in dense softmax → training module output convention
chosen_interpretation: Return logits and apply softmax externally
justification: Stable cross-entropy/focal-loss contract; same probability mapping
expected_experimental_consequence: Numerical training behavior changes if softmax duplicated

paper_statement_and_problem: Table 1/Figure 3 do not supply a fully executable topology in accessible paper text
justification: Exact layer-to-layer and fusion wiring cannot be established
possible_alternative: Obtain original code or author clarification

paper_statement_and_problem: Figure 3 and Table 1 are images in the paper PDF → their visual details were inaccessible during Stage 8
chosen_interpretation: Keep visual paper check open; do not certify paper-faithful training readiness yet
justification: Full text and captions cannot substitute for visual inspection of wiring/table entries
possible_alternative: User supplies local PDF path or attachment
expected_experimental_consequence: Could require revision of stage taps, module placement, or fusion topology

paper_statement_and_problem: Paper top-hat equation highlights bright features while target hair is dark; repository uses blackhat
possible_alternative: Implement top-hat version after controlled protocol decision
expected_experimental_consequence: Different hair masks and model inputs

paper_statement_and_problem: Paper mentions crop, model size, and 20 augmentations without operational parameters
chosen_interpretation: Do not add crop or new transforms; use 384 only for synthetic compatibility check
possible_alternative: Author parameters or separately prespecified design
expected_experimental_consequence: Future training protocol must declare deviations

paper_statement_and_problem: EfficientNet is explicitly pretrained; ResNet pretrained status unclear
chosen_interpretation: Both constructors allow pretrained weights but Stage 8 verification uses `False`
justification: Prevents network download and separates structure from weights
possible_alternative: Initialize either/both from ImageNet in Stage 9
